title: Machine Mirages: Defining the Undefined
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. This paper is theoretical and does not present or conduct a benchmark measuring faith or religion. It focuses on formally defining computational pathologies in AI systems.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith, and therefore presents no findings on the topic.
